records.label: Native / Custom Profile Field Composition
records.notes: Core WP_User/account fields and custom user meta are distinct native data families; reusable custom control schema remains Fields-owned.

records.label: Avatar / Cover Image References
records.notes: get_avatar() is native substrate; cover/private media remains delegated to the media/file owner.

records.label: Biography / Social / Contact Data
records.notes: Native description/contact/user-meta substrate does not define a universal social/profile schema.

records.label: Field Privacy Class
records.notes: Privacy must be enforced server-side and integrate with the native exporter/eraser lifecycle where applicable.

records.label: User-Editable vs Admin-Only
records.notes: Native capability/profile hooks are authorization substrate; own-profile and edit-other-user remain distinct policies.

records.label: Public Profile Slug / Collision Policy
records.notes: User nicename/author routes are native-adjacent; dedicated profile routing/collision remains WPE-owned.

records.label: Registration Form / Username / Email Policy
records.notes: Core registration/account creation is native substrate; custom fields/approval/policy remain composed.

records.label: Default Role / Role Allowlist Reference
records.notes: Role assignment truth remains Surface 30 / Policy-owned; Profile stores references only.

records.label: Login / Logout / Password Reset Surfaces
records.notes: Integrates native account surfaces without creating a private authentication engine.

records.label: Directory Query / Listing Reference
records.notes: WP_User_Query is native query substrate; canonical Query/Listings ownership remains delegated.

records.label: Filters / Search / Sort / Pagination
records.notes: User-query args provide native substrate; directory presentation remains WPE/market.

records.label: Role Inclusion / Exclusion and Privacy-Aware Output
Profile Import / Export / Dependency Mapping
records.notes: Profile definition portability excludes live credentials/passwords/secrets and separately governed user data.

records.label: Personal Data Export / Erasure / Anonymization Integration
records.notes: Outcome may be erase, anonymize, or retain-with-legal-reason; credentials/secrets are excluded from ordinary exports and multisite/site ownership is explicit.

coverage.notes: Native account/login-reset and privacy exporter/eraser families integrated. Core-user/meta/query substrates are documented while role grants, media ownership, routing, directories and presentation remain WPE/canonical-owner concerns.
